title: Nitro | 10x Faster, 3x Cheaper ETL | Espresso AI
excerpt: Nitro compiles your SQL into a formally verified Rust binary, so ETL pipelines run 10x faster and 3x cheaper than on a general data warehouse engine.

[01] How it Works

Data warehouses are built for every query. Nitro is built for yours.

1. Agents build and tune a high-performance rust binary using your SQL as a spec.

2. We formally verify that the binary is equivalent to your SQL, mathematically guaranteeing correctness.

3. Your jobs run 10x faster.

In
Your SQL pipeline, on Snowflake or Databricks.

Out
High-performance Rust.

Proof
Machine-checked formal verification. We can run both side-by-side so you can check for yourself.
